title: Create my event stream
description: Create the caller's personal Customer Analytics event stream — a live feed of selected accounts' events posted to a Slack channel of their choice. Each user has at most one stream per project (409 if one already exists; use event-streams-list first). Provide `event_names` to watch, and optionally `slack_integration` + `slack_channel_id` for delivery — the stream only delivers once events, a Slack channel, and at least one member account are all configured and `enabled` is true.

methodDocumentation.text:
The caller's event stream: a live feed of selected accounts' events posted to a
Slack channel of their choice. Per-user — each team member owns at most one stream, and
every endpoint is scoped to the caller's own. Delivery runs through a managed CDP
destination that is re-provisioned inside the same transaction as every write, so
config and delivery can't drift apart.

Create the caller's personal Customer Analytics event stream — a live feed of selected accounts' events posted to a Slack channel of their choice. Each user has at most one stream per project (409 if one already exists; use event-streams-list first). Provide `event_names` to watch, and optionally `slack_integration` + `slack_channel_id` for delivery — the stream only delivers once events, a Slack channel, and at least one member account are all configured and `enabled` is true.
